_meta.rule: HOTLINES: NEVER add or edit a hotline/text-line number without a human verifying it against an authoritative source (source=national_verified, verified=true). EMERGENCY numbers (police/ambulance/fire): emitted only under the owner's cited-sources standard of 2026-10-29 — >=2 independent agreeing sources, >=1 official, source=multi_source_cited (CIRISAgent#1248). A wrong crisis number is catastrophically worse than the directory fallback.

verification_notes: No human-verified national hotline entries for this locale yet — international directories only. See CRISIS_RESOURCES_VERIFICATION_NEEDED.md before adding entries; numbers require human verification (verified=true) against an authoritative source. Emergency (police/ambulance/fire) numbers for ID added 2026-10-29 (CIRISAgent#1248): 3 of 5 meet the owner's cited-sources standard (source=multi_source_cited, emitted); the rest are staged verified=false and NOT emitted — see CRISIS_RESOURCES_VERIFICATION_NEEDED.md.

emergency_indonesia_112.name: Emergency services
emergency_indonesia_112.description: Integrated emergency number (fire, accidents, medical, disasters, crime) — live in 141 cities and regencies as of 2025; where it does not connect, use the numbers below
emergency_indonesia_112.validation_notes: CITED 2026-10-29 (CIRISAgent#1248) under the owner's cited-sources standard (>=2 independent agreeing sources, >=1 official; no human check). Sources: UK FCDO travel advice: UK FCDO travel advice, Getting help: "Emergency services in Indonesia Ambulance: 118 Fire: 112 Police: 110" (fetched 2026-10-29 via gov.uk content API) | Biro Humas Kementerian Komunikasi dan Digital (Komdigi) press release on InfoPublik (govt portal): "Call Center 112 beroperasi 24 jam selama seminggu untuk memberikan respons cepat terhadap keadaan darurat, seperti kebakaran, kecelakaan, kondisi medis, bencana alam, dan tindak kriminal." (https://infopublik.id/kategori/siaran-pers/912067/siaran-pers-kurangi-risiko-bencana-saat-lebaran-komdigi-siagakan-layanan-darurat-112-dan-ews). Sources agree it reaches: ambulance, fire. Listed beyond that by some sources only: police. Conflict resolved 2026-10-29 by owner-directed second-opinion review (not human verification); FCDO said ambulance 118, fire 112, police 110, Wikipedia said 112 general, fire 113, ambulance 118/119. This number's provenance: FCDO. UK FCDO page checked: https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/indonesia/getting-help (fetched 2026-10-29); page text: UK FCDO travel advice, Getting help: "Emergency services in Indonesia Ambulance: 118 Fire: 112 Police: 110" (fetched 2026-10-29 via gov.uk content API). Cross-check (not a source): en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_emergency_telephone_numbers — wikipedia lists 112 as general emergency and fire as 113. 'languages' = the locale this entry is staged for (id), not a verified statement of operator languages.
